displayedInputs.question: The graph of a linear function passes through \((-2,0)\) and \((0,4)\). Its equation is ( ).
The graph of the linear function \(y=kx+b\) is parallel to the line \(y=2x-1\) and passes through \((1,5)\). Find the value of \(b\).
How is the \(x\)-coordinate of the intersection of the graph of the linear function \(y=2x-6\) with the \(x\)-axis related to the solution of \(2x-6=0\)?
What is the x-coordinate of the intersection of the graph of the linear function \(y=3x+9\) with the x-axis?
The graph of the linear function \(y=kx+b\) intersects the x-axis at \((-2,0)\). The solution of the equation \(kx+b=0\) in \(x\) is ( ).

The x-coordinate of the intersection of the graph of the linear function \(y=kx+b\) with the x-axis equals the solution of the equation \(kx+b=0\). Given that the solution of this equation is \(x=3\) and the graph passes through \((0,-6)\), find the value of \(k\).
Using the graph of \(y=x-2\), what is the solution set of \(x-2>0\)?
The graph of the linear function \(y=2x+4\) intersects the x-axis at \((-2,0)\), and \(y\) increases as \(x\) increases. The solution set of the inequality \(2x+4>0\) is ( ).
The line \(y=-x+3\) intersects the x-axis at \((3,0)\), and \(y\) decreases as \(x\) increases. The solution set of the inequality \(-x+3<0\) is ( ).
The graph of the linear function \(y=kx+b\) passes through \((1,2)\) and \((3,-2)\). The solution set of the inequality \(kx+b>0\) is \(x<a\). Find the value of \(a\).
What are the coordinates of the intersection of the lines \(y=x+1\) and \(y=-x+3\)?
What is the x-coordinate of the intersection of the lines $y=x+2$ and $y=2x$?
Find the coordinates of the intersection of the lines $y=2x-1$ and $y=-x+5$. (Write the x-coordinate followed by the y-coordinate, separated by a comma.)
The intersection of the lines $y=2x+1$ and $y=-x+m$ has an x-coordinate of 1. Find the value of $m$.
A taxi charges 10 yuan for a trip of up to 3 km and 2 yuan per km beyond that. What function gives the fare \(y\) for a trip of \(x\) km (\(x>3\))? (Simplify to the form \(y=kx+b\).)
A spring has an original length of 10 cm and stretches by 0.5 cm for every 1 kg of mass hung from it. What is the spring's length in cm when a 6 kg object is hung from it?
A mobile phone plan has a monthly base fee of 20 yuan and charges 0.1 yuan per minute of calls. If the total bill for a month is 50 yuan, how many minutes of calls were made?

A swimming pool charges 10 yuan per visit without a membership card. A membership card requires a one-time payment of 50 yuan, after which each visit costs 5 yuan. What is the minimum number of visits for the total cost with a membership card to be less than the total cost without one?

A city charges 2 yuan per tonne for monthly water usage up to 10 tonnes, and 3 yuan per tonne for the portion exceeding 10 tonnes. A household uses $x$ tonnes of water ($x>10$) and must pay $y$ yuan. Which expression gives $y$ as a function of $x$? ( )
The product of string length and frequency is constant. How does the frequency change when the string length is halved? (How many times the original frequency does it become? Write only the number.)
The product of string length $L$ (cm) and frequency $f$ (Hz) is the constant 12000. When the string length is 40 cm, what is the frequency in Hz?
The product of string length $L$ and frequency $f$ is constant. What type of relationship exists between $f$ and $L$? ( )
A string has a frequency of 200 Hz when its length is 60 cm. If the product of string length and frequency is constant, what is the string length in cm when the frequency is 300 Hz?
Each time the pitch rises by one octave, the frequency becomes 2 times its original value. A tone has a frequency of 220 Hz. What is its frequency in Hz after it is raised by two octaves?
What is the mean of the data 3, 5, 7, 9, 11?
The heights (cm) of 4 students are 150, 152, 158, and 160. What is their mean height in cm?
The mean of the three numbers $x$, 4, and 6 is 6. Find $x$.
The mean of 5 numbers is 10. After one more number is added, the mean of these 6 numbers becomes 11. What is the added number?
The mean of a data set is 5. If each data value is multiplied by 2 and then increased by 1, what is the mean of the resulting data? ( )
A written test score of 80 points has a weight of 40%, and an interview score of 90 points has a weight of 60%. What is the overall score? (Unit: points; write only the number.)
On a test, a score of 70 points has a weight of 2, and a score of 90 points has a weight of 3. What is the weighted mean score in points?

In a recruitment process, the written test, interview, and practical assessment are weighted in the ratio $2:3:5$. A person's scores on these three components are 85, 90, and 80 points, respectively. What is the overall score in points?

A student scored 85 points on the midterm. The semester grade is calculated with the midterm accounting for 40% and the final exam accounting for 60%. What is the minimum integer score on the final exam needed for a semester grade of at least 90 points?
In a weighted mean, a greater weight for a data value indicates that ( ).

choices.A: The data value has a greater influence on the mean
choices.B: The data value itself is larger
choices.C: The data value occurs less frequently

What is the median of the data 7, 1, 4, 9, 5?
What are the median and mode of the data 6, 2, 8, 4, 4, 10? (Write the median followed by the mode, separated by a comma.)
The 6 data values \(3, 5, 7, a, 10, 12\) are arranged in ascending order. Their median is 8. Find \(a\).
The median of 11 distinct data values is 20. How many values are greater than 20?
A set of wage data contains an extremely large value. Is the mean or the median more appropriate?
